reviewAssignment: One exhaustive current-family independent review of six exact PDFs, 32 original GHA pages and all 15 obligations; report every identifiable issue once.

ROUTE_IDENTITY.basis: The family, exact obligation route key, AOC-496.2 primary instrument and conditional AOC-496 order agree across the route record, builder, field map, source receipt and current six packet reports. The void branches are expungement after an express void, not a substitute void-and-seal motion.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.basis: Directly rehashed AOC-496.2 237812 bytes/2 pages/31 fields and AOC-496 218186 bytes/2 pages/33 fields. Both exact SHA-256 values match receipts. Held source identity is proved; freshness is not newly claimed.

COMPONENT_SET.basis: All four declared components are present as required/conditional: two-page petition, optional two-page order only in boundary, one-page certification guide and one-page filing guide. Schedule contains all actual facts. Its overinclusive trigger is a nonblocking implementation observation. Guide substance is scored separately.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.basis: All 128 reported logical writes, comprising 142 actual source-widget appearances across six PDFs, were independently read at their exact source positions; complete held identity/caption/date/list/charge values are preserved. No held value is falsely refused. Phone readability is scored under visual overlap, and route-wide companion handling is separately failed.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.basis: Signing before notary/clerk, SSN completion, certification attachment and 30-day receipt window are stated. The required certification’s issuer/request-form/action handoff is not usable from the standalone guide. Internal field/build terms are also exposed.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.basis: Current retained elections independently match Check Box19 for four ordinary fixtures, Check Box20 for KRS 218A.275(8), and Check Box21 for KRS 218A.276(8). Missing/conflicting grounds and unconfirmed order inclusion refuse. However the exact route cannot safely represent same-case companion dispositions/mixed classes, and valid non-Kentucky mailing-state choices are rejected.

REPEATING_ROWS.basis: All homogeneous retained rows and boundary counts 1–7 are present; no fixture row is dropped. Independent pure probes show charge-specific dismissed/amended disposition/date values are ignored by the real schedule function and replaced with the global conviction disposition/date. Full source-contract row support or an explicit safe handoff is absent.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.basis: All 27 actual election widgets were measured: six participant marks, twelve unselected participant choices and nine blank judicial widgets. All nonwrite field appearances are empty/removed viewer controls or unchanged source defaults. SSN, participant execution, jurat, clerk hearing/service, Other, judicial execution and agency certification remain blank, corroborated on every original page.

ARTIFACTS.basis: Six current PDFs rehash exactly to original run 34602920153 and current reports. Page counts 5/5/5/5/5/7 total 32; each parses with zero interactive fields. All 32 original PNG bytes rehash to both the original-run receipt and committed page pins.

PAGE_ORDER.basis: Each packet retains source petition pages 1–2. Boundary then includes order pages 1–2 as packet pages 3–4. Certification guide, filing guide and complete fact schedule follow in declared order. Every page is present/readable apart from the specific reported collisions.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.basis: All 32 original images independently viewed and bound. Seven phone-value/static-parenthesis collisions and six source-origin doubled agency headings prevent a clean visual verdict. No other clipped added text, missing page, or protected ink was observed. The calibrated central raster PASS remains valid geometry evidence; it does not decide these readability defects.

FILING_DESTINATION.basis: Guide names the Office of the Circuit Court Clerk in the county of the original charge, identifies Fayette County and the held address/telephone, directs one petition per criminal case and asks the participant to confirm local copies/delivery/order practice. Held factual destination matches the fixtures.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.basis: The $100 filing fee and unresolved $50 refund treatment are expressly distinguished; no refund is promised. The guide omits the source-backed motion and affidavit steps for requesting in forma pauperis relief, addressing only a participant who already obtained an order.

SERVICE.basis: The guide correctly assigns service to the clerk on the county attorney, identified victims and relevant persons, tells the participant not to serve them, and preserves clerk hearing/service/certification fields. The held minimum 30-day hearing timing and agency follow-up appear.

SELF_HELP_STOP.basis: Separate incidents, prosecutor/victim opposition, enhancement uncertainty, disputed certification, attack on conviction and venue uncertainty are carried. The source’s explicit non-US-citizen stop is weakened to the participant deciding that immigration advice is needed.

No runtime intake or commercial authority is inferred.
